Do you remember the first time you backed the car out of the driveway on your own? It was pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment was likely one of the scariest of their lives. When you were a teenager, they had no way of knowing how fast you were driving, where you went, when you arrived, or how safely you were driving. No news was good news—hope was the only real tool they had until you checked in.

If you have a teen driver now, count yourself lucky you don't have to live in that age of unknown fear for your parents. While 2026 technology has plenty of downsides, HeyPolo is a clear example of tech making teen driving safer and life better.

HeyPolo is more than just an upgraded Apple 'Find My' service

HeyPolo is a family safety app that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all for one price. The driving features are what set it apart from basic location-sharing apps like Apple's 'Find My.' Every single drive your teen takes is tracked and scored, so you can see exactly how they did: how fast they were going, whether they used a smartphone while driving, whether they braked hard or accelerated suddenly, and whether any serious driving events were detected.

The 'Driving Score' grades each trip based on their actual driving behavior, so you no longer have to guess whether your teen is really driving safely. You can see the data, have a serious conversation if their performance is poor, and as their driving habits improve, their score goes up over time. This is more useful for helping new drivers improve than anything the previous generation had access to.

Crash detection, arrival notifications, and more

HeyPolo can detect a crash and automatically notify you. Combined with arrival notifications—triggered whether your teen reaches school, practice, a friend's house, or gets back home—you go from hoping 'no news is good news' to actually knowing if they're safe. You don't have to wait for them to text or call you when they arrive; you know exactly when they get there, and that peace of mind is priceless for a parent. HeyPolo updates location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, shared by the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription covers your entire family, absolutely no extra per-person fees. It works on both iPhone and Android, so households with mixed devices don't need to worry. HeyPolo is built by the team behind Surfshark, which means it has solid privacy infrastructure behind it. They don't sell your data, you decide what you share, who you share it with, and when to stop sharing, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this is essential when it comes to privacy.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, and there are no binding contracts—there's no reason not to give it a try.
